title: This is the upcoming Moto G47 Power
description: Last week we came across an EPREL listing for the upcoming Motorola Moto G47 Power, revealing its battery capacity, and we now have official-looking renders of the device alongside more of its key specs. Unsurprisingly, the Moto G47 Power looks a lot like the regular Moto G47, though at least one of its colorways is new, with a turquoise green color. The second one is the same black shade as before. title: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max European prices and battery capacities leak
description: If you thought the leaked European prices for vivo's X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max, or Oppo's Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max were high, then you probably won't be ready for this. Today a new report claims to bring us the European prices for the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, and they are positively eye-watering. The Xiaomi 18 Pro with 256GB of storage is said to go for €1,449, while the 512GB version will set you back a whopping €1,649. title: Motorola's wide Razr Flex hits Geekbench with a surprising chipset
description: Last month, Motorola's upcoming wide foldable smartphone finally got a leaked name - it will allegedly be called the Razr Flex. This has now been confirmed through a Geekbench listing. Apparently, someone in possession of a prototype Razr Flex decided to run Geekbench 6.7.1 on it, thus confirming the name (as much as such a run can, of course - things like this can be faked). The benchmark run also revealed that the Razr Flex is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC, which is notable because past rumors have claimed it would have the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 instead. title: Leaked Galaxy S27 series cases reiterate new designs
description: The Galaxy S27 series is shaping up to be a turning point for Samsung’s flagship line. Previous rumors suggest Samsung will usher in a new design for its Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra models while still offering the Galaxy S27 and larger-screen Galaxy S27+ as its more affordable entries. A new leak from IceUniverse gives us a fresh new look at cases for all four S27 models, and it seems the Pro and Ultra design is here to stay. title: The extra rugged Crosscall Core X7 surfaces at a French retailer, followed by a rugged tablet
description: One rugged phone and one rugged tablet have surfaced on French retailer AMG Pro, which focuses on selling tactical equipment. They come from Crosscall – another French company. The Crosscall Core X7 is a rugged handset that can survive submersion up to 2m of water for 30 minutes (IPX8 rating) – and this includes salt water, which most IP rated phones avoid. The phone is also dust tight (IP6X) and resists hot water jets (IP69K). It has been drop tested 300 times from 1.2m (following the MIL-STD-810H standard) and the manufacturer claims that it can actually survive falling from 2m onto...

title: India smartphone shipments drop 26% in Q3 to the lowest level since 2016
description: According to a new report by Omdia, India's smartphone shipments fell by 26% to 35.8 million units in the third quarter (July to September) compared to the same period last year. Thus, Q3 2026 saw the lowest smartphone shipments since 2016, despite the start of the festive season. Higher prices and cautious consumer spending were to blame, unsurprisingly, and the latter is most likely caused by the former, so these aren't even really two reasons. Samsung regained the top spot for the first time since Q1 2024, shipping 6.7 million units, for about 19% of the market. Its top sellers were...

title: HMD Vibe2 Max specifications and renders leak
description: HMD could soon add a new variant to its Vibe2 series. A tipster has shared the full set of specifications and renders of an upcoming HMD Vibe2 Max. According to the leak, the HMD Vibe2 Max will sport a 6.78-inch LCD display with support for Full-HD+ resolution, 1,500 nit peak brightness, and a 120Hz refresh rate. The handset is said to be powered by the Unisoc T9100 chipset, paired with up to 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. It is tipped to run Android 16 and offer specs such as 5G connectivity, NFC, a side-mounted fingerprint scanner, and an IP64 rating. For photography, the...

title: Honor Win2, Win2 RT, and Win Turbo2 specs leak along with a live image
description: Honor is unveiling the Win2 series in China on October 21, and now a tipster on Weibo has shared specs for all three phones in the family - the Win2, the Win2 RT, and the Win Turbo2. And we also get two images to accompany them, one showing renders of the phones, the other a live one with all three devices on top of their respective retail boxes. The Honor Win2 is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset paired with LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and UFS 4.1 storage. title: vivo X500 Ultra key specifications tipped
description: The vivo X500 Ultra is reportedly set to launch in China between March and April next year. A new leak has now revealed more details about the upcoming flagship’s hardware. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, the vivo X500 Ultra will be powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. title: Samsung may launch Galaxy S27 series earlier than expected, but memory questions still linger
description: The Galaxy S26 series arrived late – the S24 generation was unveiled in mid-January and launched in late January, while the S25 generation was announced in late January and launched in early February. The S26 series was only made official in late February and came out in early March. The delay was likely caused by the last-minute switch from an S26 Edge to an S26+. The upcoming Galaxy S27 series may return to the usual January/February time frame, writes user Lanzuk on the Korean micro-blogging platform Naver. The exact timeline isn’t known yet, but, apparently, most major decisions over...

title: Redmi K100 with 10,000mAh battery and 6.83-inch display is launching next week
description: Xiaomi teased the arrival of the Redmi K100 in China last week. The company has now announced the phone’s launch date and revealed its key specs and design. It will join the K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max that were unveiled in August. The Redmi K100 will launch in China on October 28, the brand confirmed in an official post on Weibo. Alongside, Redmi also showcased the phone in a new Firefly Green colorway. title: Samsung Galaxy F70 arrives with familiar specs
description: Samsung’s latest F-series smartphone is now official in India with the launch of the Galaxy F70. This is the third entry in the F70 series, following the Galaxy F70e from February and the Galaxy F70 Pro, which launched in August. The new Galaxy F70 is the midpoint in the F-series and features plenty of similarities with last year’s Galaxy A17. Galaxy F70 is built around a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display with FHD+ resolution and a 90Hz refresh rate. The panel is protected by Corning Gorilla Glass Victus and features a waterdrop notch for its 13MP front-facing camera. Around the back, we...

title: iQOO Neo12 set to launch on October 28, design and color options revealed
description: iQOO recently confirmed that its upcoming Neo12 will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and feature a 2K AMOLED display with a 185Hz refresh rate. The company has now revealed the phone’s design, color options, and launch date in China. The iQOO Neo12 will launch in China on October 28, with pre-orders already open in the country. The phone will be available in three color options called Fierce Edge, Shadow Black, and Frost Blade Blue. title: iPhone Duo's battery capacity officially revealed
description: Apple’s iPhone Duo went up for pre-order last week, with sales and deliveries set to begin later this week. Ahead of the launch, Apple has published the EU energy label for the foldable iPhone, revealing its battery capacity and endurance ratings. The official energy label lists a 4,883mAh lithium-ion battery for the iPhone Duo, which is split into two. According to the energy label, the iPhone Duo offers a rated battery endurance of 51 hours and 30 minutes per cycle. The battery is also rated to retain its performance for at least 1,000 charge cycles under default...

title: Honor Watch 6 review
description: Welcome to our Honor Watch 6 review. I know, I know, we're a little late with this one. Okay, maybe a lot late, but in our defense, some of that tardiness comes from battery testing a watch with more than a month's worth of endurance .(or so Honor promised). That may be the Honor Watch 6's key selling point, and for good reason: charging your smartwatch once a month is about as close to having a regular watch as you can get. But I'm here to tell you that there's more to the Honor Watch 6 than simply its huge battery. It's what a watch needs to be. Note that I didn't say smartwatch...

title: Apple AirPods 5 review
description: How do you update the most popular audio product in the world? That's a question that would keep many companies awake at night. But almost a decade after the original launched, Apple has kept the classic AirPods model relevant while turning it into one of the most profitable businesses ever. The 2026 AirPods 5 keep what people love while improving everything across the board. Better noise cancellation, better audio quality, better battery life, and even better gestures. title: What is variable aperture and why should you care?
description: The iPhone 18 Pro is the first iPhone model to feature a variable aperture, a headlining feature for this year's Pro models. An adjustable aperture has been an invaluable tool for photographers on professional and prosumer camera systems, and its absence from mobile cameras has become increasingly conspicuous as everything else on these devices has leveled up. There have been a handful of phones over the years that featured a variable aperture system for their main camera. However, the feature never stuck around long enough to enter the lexicon of the average smartphone user, as most...

title: OnePlus 16 is official with 9,000mAh battery, Week 42 in review
description: The OnePlus 16 is official, with a mammoth 9,000mAh battery. The power plant supports 100W wired and 50W wireless charging. Elsewhere on the phone, there's the latest Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 (still can't cope with this name), a 6.78-inch LTPO OLED display that can go up to 185Hz in select games, and a triple camera, consisting of a 200MP wide-angle, a 50MP 3x telephoto, and a 50MP ultrawide. title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro vs. iPhone 17 Pro
description: We've got a new iPhone in town, but the age-old question remains: do I get the new iPhone, or is last year's model just as good? With the Apple iPhone 18 Pro now released, the Apple iPhone 17 Pro stock is running low as Apple has discontinued the model. However, if you act fast, you might find one that will feel just like the new iPhone, but at a lower price. After all, the upgrades this year are quite modest. description: The OnePlus 15 was the last global flagship from the company. Since it launched, OnePlus left the global market to focus only on India and China.
